in_hebrew.name: יודהיהוא
in_hebrew.long_meaning: יהוה (YHWH) - God, דוד (Dod) - judge; the name YHWH-Dod means 'God is my judge'.

in_greek.name: Θεοδών
in_greek.long_meaning: Θεός (Theos) - God, δῶν (dōn) - gift; the name Θεοδών means 'God's gift'.

in_latin.name: Goduinius
in_latin.long_meaning: Deus (Deus) - God, amicus (amicus) - friend; the name Goduinius means 'God's friend'.
